name: Okishima:1336 [RELEASE]
desc:
OKISHIMA is an immersive, physics-driven open-world samurai RPG.

Choose your path as a Ronin or Shogun, switching freely between both. Raid villages, rob homes, execute fortress heists, hunt bounties, battle Oni, and duel other players.

Experience fluid, momentum-based combat featuring procedural animations, dynamic parries, directional limb slicing, and destructible armor.

Explore a beautifully crafted island with realistic environments, atmospheric effects, and endless opportunities to forge your own path

Developed and Owned by Cowoe and F33NY
